blocks.explanation:
Yahan secant wali term ek line ke barabar hai. Tareeqa wohi graph wala hai, lekin secant ke graph mein asymptotes hoti hain, is liye zara ehtiyat chahiye.
Diya kya hai? Equation aur interval \([-\pi, \pi]\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh saare \(x\) jahan \(y = \sec(x + 3)\) aur line \(y = -2x + \frac{1}{3}\) milte hain.
Plan: pehle asymptotes aur branches pehchanein, phir table, phir graph, har crossing parhein, pakka karein aur check karein. Yeh sawal is exercise ka sab se tricky sawal hai, kyunke yahan teen roots hain.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sec(x + 3) = -2x + \frac{1}{3}\), \(x \in [-\pi, \pi]\).
Maloom karna: interval ke saare roots.
Tareeqa: \(y = \sec(x + 3)\) aur \(y = -2x + \frac{1}{3}\) ko ek hi axes par plot karenge aur intersections parhenge. Farq \(d = \sec(x + 3) - (-2x + \frac{1}{3})\) ka sign dekhenge, lekin jo sign change asymptote ke aar paar ho, usay root nahi ginenge.

\(y = \sec(x + 3)\) ki asymptotes
\(\sec(x + 3) = \frac{1}{\cos(x + 3)}\) wahan undefined hai jahan \(\cos(x + 3) = 0\):
\[x + 3 = \tfrac{\pi}{2} \Rightarrow x \approx -1.43\]
\[x + 3 = \tfrac{3\pi}{2} \Rightarrow x \approx 1.71\]
Kyun: Jab \(x\) \(-\pi\) se \(\pi\) tak jata hai to \(x + 3\) takreeban \(-0.14\) se \(6.14\) tak jata hai. Is range mein cosine sirf \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) aur \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) par zero hota hai. Zero se divide nahi ho sakta, is liye in do jagahon par graph \(\pm\infty\) ki taraf bhaag jata hai.

Teen branches
Bayen (\(-\pi \le x < -1.43\)): \(\cos(x + 3) > 0\), is liye \(\sec(x + 3) \ge 1\): ek U shakal jo \(+\infty\) tak charhti hai.
Beech (\(-1.43 < x < 1.71\)): \(\cos(x + 3) < 0\), is liye \(\sec(x + 3) \le -1\): ulta U, jis ki choti \((\pi - 3, -1) \approx (0.14, -1)\) hai.
Dayen (\(1.71 < x \le \pi\)): phir se \(\sec(x + 3) \ge 1\).
Line \(y = -2x + \frac{1}{3}\) \(x = -\pi\) par \(6.62\) se gir kar \(x = \pi\) par \(-5.95\) tak aati hai.
Kyun: Bayen branch par line (3.19 se 6.62) charhti hui U ko ek dafa kaat'ti hai. Beech wali branch hamesha \(-1\) ya us se neeche hai; line \(-1\) se neeche tab aati hai jab \(x > \frac{2}{3}\). Wahan line ulte U ki choti ke bilkul neeche se guzarti hai aur usay do dafa kaat'ti hai. Dayen branch par \(y \ge 1\) hai magar line \(-3\) se bhi neeche hai, is liye wahan koi milap nahi.
Dhyan dein: Beech wali branch ki do crossings bohat qareeb hain; chhote scale par graph banaya to ek hi dikhegi aur root chhoot jayega. Kitab ki answer key ke saath yahi hua hai.

Table of values (radians, 2 decimal)
\(x = -\pi\): \(\sec(x + 3) = 1.01\), line \(= 6.62\), \(d = -5.61\)
\(x = -2\): \(1.85\), \(4.33\), \(d = -2.48\)
\(x = -1.6\): \(5.88\), \(3.53\), \(d = 2.35\)
\(x = 0\): \(-1.01\), \(0.33\), \(d = -1.34\)
\(x = 0.5\): \(-1.07\), \(-0.67\), \(d = -0.40\)
\(x = 0.9\): \(-1.38\), \(-1.47\), \(d = 0.09\)
\(x = 1\): \(-1.53\), \(-1.67\), \(d = 0.14\)
\(x = 1.5\): \(-4.74\), \(-2.67\), \(d = -2.08\)
\(x = 2\): \(3.53\), \(-3.67\), \(d = 7.19\)
Kyun: Asli sign changes teen hain: \(-2\) aur \(-1.6\) ke darmiyan, 0.5 aur 0.9 ke darmiyan, aur 1 aur 1.5 ke darmiyan. \(-1.6\) aur 0 ke darmiyan, aur 1.5 aur 2 ke darmiyan bhi sign badalta hai, lekin wahan asymptote hai: secant \(+\infty\) se seedha \(-\infty\) par chhalang lagata hai. Wahan graphs milte nahi, is liye woh roots nahi hain.
Dhyan dein: Asymptote ke aar paar ka sign change root nahi hota. Hamesha pehle asymptotes kheenchein.

Graph bana kar intersections parhein
Pehle dashed asymptotes, phir teeno branches aur line kheenchein (figure dekhiye). Graphs in jagahon par milte hain:
\[x \approx -1.70,\ 0.80,\ 1.22\]
Kyun: Teen intersection points hain, to teen roots. Dayen wale do points qareeb qareeb hain, is liye us hisse ka graph bara scale le kar banayein.

2 decimal tak pakka karein
\(d(-1.705) = -0.071\), \(d(-1.695) = +0.084\)
\(d(0.795) = -0.003\), \(d(0.805) = +0.008\)
\(d(1.215) = +0.001\), \(d(1.225) = -0.019\)
Kyun: Har jore mein sign badalta hai, yani har root un do values ke beech hai; round karne par \(-1.70\), \(0.80\) aur \(1.22\) milte hain.

Tasdeeq
\(x = -1.70\): \(\sec(1.30) = 3.738\), line \(= 3.733\)
\(x = 0.80\): \(\sec(3.80) = -1.264\), line \(= -1.267\)
\(x = 1.22\): \(\sec(4.22) = -2.115\), line \(= -2.107\)
Kyun: Teeno roots par dono sides takreeban 0.01 tak barabar hain, is liye teeno jawab sahi hain.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x \approx -1.70,\ 0.80,\ 1.22\) radians
Yani is interval mein teen roots hain, sirf ek nahi.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of y = sec(x + 3) (blue) on minus pi to pi with dashed vertical asymptotes at x = pi/2 minus 3 (about minus 1.43) and x = 3pi/2 minus 3 (about 1.71): a U-shaped branch on the left rising to infinity, an upside-down U in the middle with top point (0.14, minus 1), and another U on the right. The falling line y = minus 2x + 1/3 (pink) cuts the left branch at x about minus 1.70 and the middle branch twice, at x about 0.80 and 1.22.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein sirf \(x = -1.66\) radians likha hai, jo adhoora bhi hai aur ghalat bhi. \(x = -1.66\) par \(\sec(1.34) \approx 4.37\) hai jab ke \(-2(-1.66) + \frac{1}{3} \approx 3.65\); barabar nahi. Bayen branch ka asal root \(x = -1.7003\ldots \approx -1.70\) hai, aur line beech wali branch ko bhi do dafa kaat'ti hai: \(x \approx 0.80\) aur \(x \approx 1.22\). Sahi jawab: \(x \approx -1.70,\ 0.80,\ 1.22\) radians.
